basic_info.description: Directly across from Golden Gate Park, this elegant top-floor condo offers three bedrooms, two baths, and a spectacular setting. A grand living and dining area features a gas fireplace, hardwood floors, and floor-to-ceiling windows framing sweeping views of the ocean, Sutro Tower, and the Golden Gate Bridge. The passthrough kitchen is appointed with stainless steel appliances, including a French door refrigerator, Bosch dishwasher, range, microwave, and double sinkperfect for entertaining and everyday living.    The floor plan includes a spacious front bedroom overlooking the park and two serene bedrooms at the back. The bright primary suite offers a large walk-in closet and an ensuite bath with double vanity and glass-enclosed shower. Both rear bedrooms open through French doors to a sprawling private deck, ideal for al fresco dining or quiet lounging.    A hall bath with marble-topped vanity and mosaic tile floors, in-unit laundry, and two-car garage parking complete the home. Professionally managed and featuring a shared roof deck with city views, it's ideally located near transit, shops, and restaurants in NOPA, the Haight, Cole Valley, and the Inner Richmond.
